name: Biblical Atlas MCP
description: MCP server for the biblical-atlas Bible atlas, with nine read-only tools for people, places, events, reigns, letters, journeys and Bible passages, and links to each record's sources. Names and summaries are in Spanish.

BIBLICAL_ATLAS_DATA_URL.description: URL of the atlas data file (defaults to https://biblical-atlas.geiser.cloud/data.json)

BIBLICAL_ATLAS_DATA_FILE.description: Path to a local copy of data.json; when set, no network is used
